consumer.text: Your computer has the film, the music, the work. But you'd rather be on the sofa.
Most remote desktop apps send your screen as a slideshow. Late, blurry, and silent.
VidVNC streams your desktop as video instead. Fluid, with clear stereo sound.
Same desk. Same network. Nothing to wait for.
About sixty-three milliseconds, screen to screen, in full HD. And it streams up to 4K.

Scan it, or type the short key, in a browser. No app to install.
On your phone, your tablet, or a compatible smart TV. From a Mac or a Windows PC.
Just watch, or take the keyboard and mouse when you allow it. On a phone, your finger is the mouse.
It stays on your network. Everything is encrypted, and every new device needs your OK.
VidVNC. Your desktop, in real time, on every screen at home.

developer.text: Traditional VNC sends your screen as a trickle of still pictures.
Every click lands late. Every drag stutters. And the sound? It never arrives.
VidVNC streams your desktop as video instead. Fluid, with clear stereo sound.
Same desk. Same network. Nothing to wait for.
About sixty-three milliseconds, screen to screen, in full HD. And it streams up to 4K.
developer.caption: About 63 milliseconds, screen to screen, in full HD. And it streams up to 4K.

developer.text: Open the app. Show a code.
Scan the code, or type the short key. No app to install.
Or, if the host allows it, register a device once. Then it signs in with a username and password. Passkeys come in a later release.
Hand over the keyboard and mouse only when you choose.
On a Mac or a Windows PC, the graphics hardware does the work.
Fast is easy to promise. Trusted takes design.
Every part is placed by how much it trusts what reaches it.
Traffic from the network meets one guarded port, and only proven senders get through.
The video connection runs in a sandbox. Break in, and it still can't see your screen, send input, or read your files.
It reaches the trusted side only through narrow pipes. Screen capture never touches the network.
Everything is encrypted. Remote access stays off until you turn it on, and codes work once.
VidVNC. Your desktop, in real time, on your network.
